Bir Raghab Moran
In the annals of medieval Assam history, among all the notable personalities,
                the name of Bir Raghab Moran is always remembered for his courage, bravery,
                leadership, and sacrifices for the sake of the Assamese proletariats.
He played a very significant role in the Moamoria Rebellion during the reign of
                Swargadeo Laksmi Singha which was a spontaneous outburst of simmering
                discontentment against the exploitative nature of the Ahom regime.
In various circumstances, Raghab Moran alias Raghab Neog himself faced a number
                of discriminations and hardships from the authoritarian Ahom administration.
Kirtichandra Barbarua’s physical torture and assault not only made him angry
                but also the entire Moamaria sect was thereby insulted. Besides, the religious
                policies adopted by the contemporary Ahom rulers posed a great challenge to
                the Moamarias, leading to resentment and rising rebellion against Ahom rule.
Raghab Moran, along with his friends and followers, organized and united the
                Moamarias against the mighty Ahom rulers to take revenge and establish the
                Moamarias in a legitimate position within the feudal Ahom society.
